cohort: Twin gestations managed at Ekiti State University Teaching Hospital, Ado-Ekiti, Nigeria between January 2009 and December 2012
finding: The study found that twin pregnancies had a prevalence of 4.3%, were associated with preterm labor, and had a perinatal mortality rate of 105 per 1000 deliveries, which was significantly higher among unbooked patients.
mod_finding: Spontaneous vaginal delivery was the most common mode of delivery, accounting for 52.6% and 49.3% of deliveries for twin 1 and twin 2, respectively, while the most common indication for caesarean delivery was breech presentation in the first twin.
